title: Before meets after
description: A smooth reveal makes two treatments easy to compare in one view.
useCase: Compare image grading, themes or visual edits without switching back and forth between separate images.
reducedMotion: The reveal follows the slider immediately. Keyboard adjustments also skip the spring.
limitations: Uses original inline SVG artwork. Replace both landscape layers with equally sized images and suitable alternative text for real projects.
look: Pale sage page with a rounded flat-vector mountain scene, warm colour left and desaturated grey right, divided by a round handle, with a slider below.
motion: Dragging across the image or the range slider moves a divider and clip-path reveal on a stiff, well-damped spring; keyboard steps jump straight to the value.
adapt: `position` is a `useSpring` (`stiffness: 380, damping: 36, mass: 0.5`) mapped to `clipPath` as `inset(0 ${100 - current}% 0 0)` and to `x` on a full-width handle-positioning layer. The handle translates without layout; the clip-path reveal remains a separate rendering cost. Replace both `Landscape` layers with equal-sized images and alt text; keep `jump` for keyboard and reduced motion.
